title: Three Vegan Bento Boxes: Totoro Inari Sushi, Panda Pancake Bento, and Temari Sushi
summary: Goodful host Natsuko demonstrates three plant-based bento-box ideas inspired by Japanese cuisine: a Totoro-themed vegan inari sushi box built from brown-rice-filled inari pouches with seaweed and cheese accents; a panda-pancake themed box featuring banana-based pancakes colored with black sesame/tahini and cocoa for a panda face; and a temari-style vegan sushi box assembled with small rice balls and a variety of vegetable and konnyaku fillings. The video emphasizes kid-friendly character design, decorative cutting (cookie cutters and nori), non-plastic shaping methods, and substitutions such as vegan mayo as glue, oat-milk/Vinegar egg substitutes, and plant-based protein and seaweed alternatives. It also highlights color and texture contrasts, practical assembly tips, and a picnic-pallette approach to creating visually appealing, nutrition-conscious lunches for kids.
topics: vegan cheese shapes with cookie cutters
rice paper wraps for teriyaki veggie rolls
non-beef substitute in sushi (rice paper technique)
egg substitute with oat milk + vinegar
black sesame tahini and cocoa panda coloring

sections.title: Totoro-inspired vegan inari sushi Bento
sections.description: Introduction to a Totoro-themed vegan bento built with seasoned brown rice tucked into inari pouches; ears added to form Totoro’s head, and facial features created with nori and vegan cheese cutouts. Vegan mayo is used as a glue to help eyes, nose, or small details, tying together a kid-friendly character bentō.

sections.title: Panda Pancake Bento
concepts: black panda coloring (black sesame tahini + cocoa)
sections.description: A panda-themed bento box built around a banana-based pancake batter, using oat milk and vinegar to mimic eggs, with color accents created from black sesame tahini and cocoa. The panda face is completed with minimal vegan chocolate for the nose and a small fruit garnish to enhance appeal.

sections.title: Vegan Sushi Temari Bento
concepts: brown rice with rice vinegar seasoning
sections.description: A vegan sushi set built as bowl-shaped temari pieces using non-plastic wrap to shape uniform rice balls (30 g each). Toppings include maguro-inspired tomato, radish petals, carrot and asparagus, woven cucumber, pickled radish, and konnyaku-based vegan-squid sushi, with dashi-based marinades and soy for flavor. The section highlights balanced color, texture, and plant-based variety in a festive, finger-friendly format.
